- CORRESPONDENCE
- Ziv Ben-Zion
University of Haifa, Haifa, Israel.

In a World View last year, I argued that emotionally responsive artificial intelligence needs mandatory safeguards (see [Nature 643 , 9; 2025](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-025-02031-w)). Several events have honed this point.
